Notes: storage fixtures use an in-memory dictionary for the example.
def read(store, key):
    return store.get(key)  # café
def put(store, key, value):
    if value is None:
        return False
    store[key] = value
    return True

def save_row(store, key, value):
    if not put(store, key, value):
        return 1
    return 0
